text: This name of brother does indeed carry with it a fine and delectable sound... but the complication of interests, the division of estates, and that the wealth of the one should be the property of the other, strangely relax and weaken the fraternal tie: brothers pursuing their fortune and advancement by the same path, 'tis hardly possible but they must of necessity often jostle and hinder one another.
author: Michel de Montaigne
translation: Charles Cotton, ed. W. C. Hazlitt, 1877
